description:
crl.rs:139 — pub fn with_delta() returns crate::Result<Self> but is missing a # Errors rustdoc section. clippy::missing_errors_doc (pedantic) flags this.

Fix: add # Errors section listing the variants that can be returned:
- Error::CrlParseError — DER decode of base or delta CRL failed
- Error::DeltaCrlBaseMismatch — base is itself a delta, delta has no deltaCRLIndicator, or issuers differ
- Error::CrlNumberMismatch — delta's BaseCRLNumber exceeds base's CRLNumber
title: [rusty/pkix-revocation] add # Errors section to CrlChecker::with_delta
